title: Transforming Cities: Turning food waste into power
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Turning food waste into power,” an urban initiative documented for Rio de Janeiro. It is included because it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.

intervention.objectives: A community project in Washington DC that is giving back to locals and ensuring their homes are comfortable and energy efficient.
intervention.measures:
Discover the experts aiming for a more circular economy for food waste in Brazil 
 Behind the scenic beaches and lively nightlife of Rio de Janeiro is a serious challenge: food waste. EcoParque is tackling the issue with creative solutions, from food banks to lights powered by compost. Learn how this organisation is helping Brazil cut methane emissions by reducing waste.
 MORE FROM THE ‘TRANSFORMING CITIES’ SERIES 
 This content was produced for Global Methane Hub by BBC StoryWorks as part of the Transforming Cities series presented by C40 Cities. Learn more about Transforming Cities: www.transformingcitiesseries.com
